_doc: Agent Triforge — Antigravity permission guardrails, expressed in agy's action(target) syntax. Enforcement evidence lives in the newest ops/research/*-probe-record.md (rows AGY-08/09/10 and the native-mode rows AGY-12/13/16).

This file is documentation + a mergeable block. templates/.antigravity/settings.json ships the same `permissions` object for project bootstrap (it records deny INTENT — project-tier settings.json is not read headless, see below). The only settings tier agy documents and enforces headless is the user tier, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json; a user who wants the denies enforced merges this block there by hand. Triforge never writes the user tier (R18).

Deny intent — three `command(<prefix>)` actions. agy's shell tool is `run_command` and its permission action is `command`; `run_shell_command` was the Gemini-CLI tool name and agy has no such tool (a `run_shell_command(...)` deny entry matches nothing):
git push -> deny: command(git push)  (subagents never touch remotes — the lead promotes)

Per-agent shell denial: the flat deny vocabulary has no per-agent scoping, so it is expressed in each agent's frontmatter instead. architecture-reviewer and documentation-writer carry `commandExecutionPolicy: "off"` and omit `run_command` from `tools` — the omission IS the denial. codebase-analyst and targeted-researcher carry `commandExecutionPolicy: auto` with `run_command`, so the deny list below is their backstop.

Enforcement facts (agy 1.2.x, re-probed 2026-09-11): AGY-08 — project-tier hooks written in the documented `.agents/hooks.json` named-hook shape (events PreInvocation/PostInvocation/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop) FIRED headless on agy 1.2.0 (lead marker-file re-probe, 05:03) — the July 'hooks inert headless' finding was a probe-shape error — but the harness re-run on agy 1.2.1 the same evening recorded FAIL with both hooks.json files loaded; headless agy hooks are an open watch, and Triforge ships none. AGY-09 — deny rules do NOT survive --dangerously-skip-permissions, so the invocation helper never passes that flag. AGY-10 — --sandbox does not confine, so it is not used. Project-tier settings.json (.gemini/, .agents/, .antigravity/) is NOT read headless.

What enforces what: (1) the per-agent `tools` allowlist + `commandExecutionPolicy` in agents/*.md is the PRIMARY guardrail in every mode. (2) Injection mode (TRIFORGE_AGY_MODE=injection, the shipped default — KTD10) keeps agy's headless permission auto-deny: shell commands and writes outside the workspace grant are soft-denied and surface in the JSON envelope's `denied_actions`, which invoke_antigravity records. (3) Native mode (TRIFORGE_AGY_MODE=native, or auto when `agy agents` lists the name) runs the two `auto` agents with `run_command` live, and the enforced boundary for them is the user-tier deny list in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json — which only the user writes. The default flips to auto only after AGY-12 (native round-trip) and AGY-16 (an `auto` agent told to rm -rf a sentinel and git push executes neither) have passed for a full cycle.
